watches.name: Bruvik Black Gold First Oil Johan Sverdrup
watches.description: A Story Preserved Under Pressure 61°12′N · 2°17′E The Bruvik Black Gold First Oil Johan Sverdrup is part of the opening chapter of FIELD SERIES — a collection inspired by defining discoveries beneath the Norwegian Continental Shelf. At its core lies the Hydracapsule® — a sealed sapphire capsule embedded in the caseback, containing a microdrop of genuine oil from the Johan Sverdrup field, carefully prepared and blended with an organic carrier fluid. A moving air bubble creates a constantly changing composition with every movement of the wrist. Nothing is programmed. Nothing is repeated. Only gravity, movement and physics. Johan Sverdrup was discovered in 2010 , with first oil on 5 October 2019 . The Hydracapsule caseback displays the field name, coordinates, year of discovery and date of first oil, creating a physical connection between the watch and the discovery it represents. Crafted in DLC-coated 316L stainless steel with warm rose gold-coloured details, the 41 mm timepiece is powered by the Sellita SW300 Swiss automatic movement with a 56-hour power reserve. It is supplied with a pull-up leather strap with orange stitching and an additional black FKM rubber strap. Specifications: Case and Hydracapsule® • DLC-coated 316L stainless steel case • Rose gold-coloured PVD-coated caseback • Hydracapsule® with a microdrop of genuine oil from the Johan Sverdrup field, blended with an organic carrier fluid • Sapphire crystal on the front and caseback • Multi-layer anti-reflective coating • Screw-down crown • Water-resistant to 200 metres • Dimensions: 41 mm diameter × 48 mm lug-to-lug × 11.9 mm height Movement • Sellita SW300 – Swiss automatic movement • 56-hour power reserve Dial and Hands • Engraved dial with applied hour markers • Swiss Super-LumiNova® for excellent low-light legibility • Brushed rose gold-coloured hour, minute and seconds hands Straps • Pull-up leather strap with orange stitching • Black FKM rubber strap included Warranty • 3-year warranty

The refined 32 mm case, elegant 5-link bracelet and slim profile create a beautifully balanced timepiece that feels equally at home in everyday life and on life's most elegant occasions. Inspired by the tranquil beauty of Nordic evenings, Misty Evening is a graceful expression of Scandinavian design, where elegance meets quiet confidence. watches.description: An Icon by Nature The Bruvik Fjord Hydracapsule® is a celebration of Norwegian nature, innovation, and design heritage. At its core lies the patented Hydracapsule® Module 3 — a sealed chamber embedded in the caseback, containing authentic fjord water from the Langfoss waterfall, collected in 2010. Positioned directly against the wrist, this rare element serves as a constant reminder of your connection to the raw beauty of nature. Crafted in satin-brushed 316L steel, this 41 mm timepiece blends rugged materials with refined details. Powered by the Sellita SW300 Swiss automatic movement with a 56-hour power reserve, the watch includes both an FKM rubber strap and a patinated leather strap for versatile wear. watches.name: Bruvik Arctic Ocean Passage Chronograph Black
watches.description: The Arctic Ocean Passage Chronograph Black is a striking homage to the Norwegian spirit of discovery. With a deep black dial, sandblasted surfaces, and vintage chronograph pushers, this model echoes the instruments once used to navigate polar extremes. Inspired by Fridtjof Nansen’s 1896 Arctic expedition aboard Fram 1, it features compass-themed dial accents and a side-mounted plate engraved with the expedition’s endpoint. Its Swiss Sellita SW510 manual-wind movement offers 62 hours of power — a nod to enduring time under harshest conditions. A watch of character, history, and bold design — delivered with both a black leather strap and a sandblasted steel bracelet. Specifications Case: 42 mm stainless steel, sandblasted finish Crystal: Domed sapphire crystal Dial: Black with Arabic numerals, index markers, and compass-inspired design Crown & Pushers: Screw-down crown with vintage-style chronograph pushers Movement: Swiss manual-wind Sellita SW510 Elaboré with 63-hour power reserve Water Resistance: 100 meters (10 ATM) Functions: Hours, minutes, small seconds, date, and chronograph Bracelet/Strap: Delivered with brown leather strap and sandblasted stainless steel bracelet Clasp: Standard pin buckle Other: Luminous hands, engraved expedition coordinates on case side

watches.name: Bruvik Fjord N2.0 Black Deep
watches.description: The Wave Dial Black captures the raw power of Svalbard’s Arctic oceans at night — cold, endless, and untamed. This dial reflects the sea in shadow, a force that shapes everything it touches. For those who move through the dark with clarity and strength. The Fjord N2.0 Black Deep is a striking tribute to the dark depths of Norway’s fjords — mysterious, powerful, and endlessly captivating. Crafted in stainless steel and coated with Dianoir Version II DLC, one of the most advanced and durable coatings available, it achieves a deep black tone of exceptional hardness and longevity. Its matte dial features a radiant engraved pattern that subtly hints at the maritime theme of the Fjord series. The black diamond-cut hands, filled with luminous white material, contrast beautifully with the dial, while the white GMT hand offers precise tracking of a second time zone over a full 24-hour scale — a practical and poetic reminder of home when traveling far north or beyond. Delivered on an integrated, super-flexible rubber strap with a repeating 3D pattern and double folding clasp, the Black Deep is both bold and refined — made for those who thrive where light meets shadow. Designed in Norway, built in Switzerland.
